title: About Us
metaDescription: Meet the clinical team behind Dallas Detox Center — a Joint Commission accredited, physician-led detox and residential program on a private 32-bed campus in Texas.

blocks.text: WE ARE YOUR PARTNERS IN PERMANENT RECOVERY

blocks.html: We built Dallas Detox Center to be a clinical sanctuary where recovery finally sticks. Our team provides the elite medical and emotional oversight you need to overcome addiction in a private, high-end setting.
blocks.text: We built Dallas Detox Center to be a clinical sanctuary where recovery finally sticks. Our team provides the elite medical and emotional oversight you need to overcome addiction in a private, high-end setting.

blocks.html: At Dallas Detox Center, we pride ourselves on understanding the importance of implementing a balance of emotional, spiritual, and physical well-being for each individual throughout the process of continuous growth both during and after treatment. DDC is here to empower those suffering from the disease of addiction by walking them through proven recovery methods that they can then use and apply to sustain recovery in their daily lives.

blocks.html: At Dallas Detox Center, we know that recovery is possible because we see it and live it every day. In knowing that each person deserves the help required to live a life free from the sufferings of addiction and alcoholism, we are able to truly dedicate ourselves to each client that comes to our program. DDC will aid in identifying the underlying issues that have led to those sufferings and treat the individual as a whole by rebuilding their lives upon their newfound belief that they are worthy of a meaningful life.

Why Dallas Detox Center Is Your Top Choice

items: 360 Individualized Care Every client that enters our program is offered a unique experience personalized to their individual needs when seeking treatment.
Home Away From Home Our residential setting is located on multiple acres of land, providing our clients with an escape while focusing on healing.
Unique Therapies Dallas Detox Center is proud to offer a number of unique therapies designed to fit each clients personal situtaions.
Highly-Experienced Staff The team at Dallas Detox Center boasts over 30+ years of combined treatment experience. Our team provides a judgment-free environment where clients can recover in peace.
Luxury Amenities Our newly renovated detox & inpatient facility, located just outside metro Dallas, offers luxury amenities such as semi-private rooms with flat-screen TVs, and more.

Lifetime Aftercare Once you become a part of the DDC family, you are with us for life. Our clients will have access to lifetime aftercare, from visits, to calls, to re-admission; we are here to help, always.
